heading: Merchandise
intro: A small collection in the works — a few well-made things that support the everyday side of looking after yourself.
body:
This isn't a shop full of slogans. The plan is a short, deliberate range: things you would actually use, made properly, with the same thinking behind them as the rest of my work.

Nothing is on sale yet. The pieces below are what is in development — if there is something you would buy that isn't here, tell me, because the range is still being decided.

products.name: Reflective Journal
products.description: A guided journal built around the questions that come up most often in therapy — structured enough to be useful, open enough to be yours.

products.name: Grounding Card Deck
products.description: A pocket set of grounding and regulation exercises, for the moments when remembering any of them is the hard part.

products.name: Organic Cotton Tote
products.description: Plain, sturdy and quietly branded. No affirmations printed down the side.

products.name: Ceramic Mug
products.description: For the cup of tea that marks the end of the working day, rather than the middle of it.

cta.heading: Want to Know When It Launches?
cta.text: Send me a message and I will let you know as soon as the range is available — and tell me what you would like to see in it.
